primitives.name: Goal Line Usage Analyst
primitives.verbatim_quote: THE GOAL LINE — who actually gets the ball inside the 5 > You are my goal line usage analyst.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_{gl}': 'dimensionless usage share inside 5-yard line', 'N_{gl}': 'total goal-line carries for team'}
primitives.assumptions: Player role is determined by actual carry/data, not assumed position or name.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When U_gl < 0.1, signal is weak; when U_gl > 0.4, strong indicator of TD potential.

layer2.mapping: Maps observed goal-line carries to conditional TD probability using kernel density estimation over recent games.
layer2.telemetry: Observed goal-line carries per game, adjusted for opponent strength.

primitives.name: Red Zone Usage Analyst
primitives.verbatim_quote: THE RED ZONE — a player's real share of work inside the 20 > You are my red zone usage analyst.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_{rz}': 'dimensionless red-zone share of targets/carries', 'N_{rz}': 'total red-zone plays for team'}
primitives.assumptions: Red-zone performance is measured by actual involvement, not total volume.
primitives.breakdown_regime: U_rz < 0.15 indicates low impact; U_rz > 0.35 signals high TD probability.

layer2.mapping: Estimates TD contribution based on normalized red-zone play share using time-series smoothing.
layer2.telemetry: Red-zone targets and carries, filtered by snap count and game state.

primitives.name: Explosive Scoring Analyst
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Rule:** *The best player on the field is often not the one who punches it in.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'D_{score}': 'average depth of scoring play (yards)', 'S_{speed}': "player's top speed (mph)"}
primitives.assumptions: Scoring type depends on play depth and player physical profile.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D_score > 20, player is distance scorer; if D_score < 5, goal-line scorer.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between scoring depth and player velocity profile to classify TD type.
layer2.telemetry: Historical scoring depth and speed data from game logs.
